body:
The fixture registry could not revoke a task before its first checkpoint, and checkpoint handlers could begin more work or release a response after cancellation or expiry. This draft adds exact-current owner revocation and checks every awaited boundary, while preserving unknown-commit liability during failed or canceled reconciliation. No live owner caller or worker revocation route is introduced.

It also repairs the inventory test's output-induced directory mutation, binds the collector to the reviewed current context, and updates the stable-source reference to accepted PR7. All 44 stable files match PR7; membership, exclusions, execution identities and authority checks remain intact. These changes have separate independent ACCEPT_SOURCE reviews. Of 2,884 base files, 2,876 remain unchanged; original tests, public/private contracts, migrations, locks and canonical capability registry are preserved except the explicitly reviewed fixture setup and source-hash literals.

Validation: integrated root244/244, focused56/56, independent lifecycle83/83, public7/7 plus generated-byte/type checks, inventory26/26, context17/17, source guards15/15, publication9/9, actual Git baseline controls14/14 and alternative metadata106/106 passed. The original build suite remains35 PASS plus one unchanged Windows-owner runtime error (exit1). PostgreSQL cases are authored and syntax checked but UNRUN. Raw failures, reviewer corrections and cleanup limitations remain in the evidence.

Source/review integration: `2d570b0015637572beb413f813f6e486751216ad`. Report/evidence: `f648af9692ea3ab91c7ccdf3f54e02cd7f7156c8`, tree `0c186864c8c4258392e88665f52de8e84abf9a79`. Stacked on preserved PR13 `690bac4cd44112b161d8e02818aeae7639ce237a`; original author/reviewer branches and historical baseline `f118ff55dfb96ba4b44099953e6c9724064b723d` are separately preserved.

The Linux comparison provides Ubuntu26.04/24.04 compatibility and immutable metadata leads, but all54 security obligations remain OPEN; no replacement image recipe is selected or built. The native recovery packet retains the no-reparse rule and requires a concrete verified existing interpreter before proposing another bounded diagnostic. No candidate interpreter or original collector cause is established.

G0 accepted/G1 OPEN/G2–G7 unentered. Scope remains139 capabilities:96 selected/43 deferred,14 bound unavailable/82 unmapped. Live identity/revocation wiring, durable budgets, native recovery, sandbox/renderer, egress/teardown, artifact inspection and supported patched-image evidence remain gates. No main merge, frontend/capirov2 edit, cloud build/push/launch, resource/credential change, customer-data action or paid provider call occurred.
